boss.isekai_mahou.guardian_defeated: %s has been defeated! The Guardian Core resonates with your power.
boss.isekai_mahou.guardian_out_of_arena: The Guardian can only be harmed from inside its arena!
boss.isekai_mahou.guardian_no_hiding: There is no hiding from a Guardian!
command.isekai_mahou.spawnboss.guardian_: The boss could not be summoned here.
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.intro: Who dares tread upon the embers of my temple? Burn!
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.phase2.line: You stoked the furnace... now burn in blue fire!
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.phase3.line: If I fall, I take this world down with me in flames!
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.death: The flames... fade... but the ember... remains...
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.hint.slam: Tip: the wave of flames runs along the ground — JUMP as it passes!
boss.isekai_mahou.ignis.hint.supernova: Tip: run out of the red circle or hide behind a pillar!
boss.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.intro: The tides obey me. Drown in silence.
boss.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.phase2.l: The sea rises! Feel the weight of the ocean!
boss.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.phase3.l: Sky and sea are one. Let the thunder judge you!
boss.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.death: I... return... to the bottom of the sea...
boss.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.hint.bub: A circle of water is chasing you — step out once it stops!
Trapped in a bubble! Hit the bubble (or ask for help) to pop it!
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_golem.intro: ...The mountain... has awoken. Intruders... will be... buried.
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_golem.phase: The earth... protects me. Blades... cannot wound... the mountain.
Tip: the earthquake only hits those on the ground — JUMP when the wave arrives!
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_golem.shiel: The Golem encases itself in stone! Only magic can crack the shield!
The Stone Shield shattered! The Golem is vulnerable!
Physical attacks can't crack the stone — use magic!
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.intro: Hahaha! Another one come to challenge the sky? Fly, if you can!
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.phase2.line: Now the wind will truly howl!
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.phase3.line: There is nowhere to hide from the sky!
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.death: The wind... never dies... it only... changes direction...
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.hint.wind_curta: Tip: the walls of wind rotate — walk along with the gap between them!
boss.isekai_mahou.zephyr.hint.vacuum: Tip: run against the wind out of the red circle, then jump the wave!
